Offboarding.title: Offboarding Record
Offboarding.description: Represents an employee IT offboarding record including Entra ID, Intune, email, SaaS, and physical exit checklist items.

id.description: Unique identifier of the offboarding record

employeeName.description: Full name of the offboarding employee

employeeEmail.description: Company email address of the employee

lastWorkingDay.description: ISO date string of the employee's last working day (YYYY-MM-DD)

manager.description: Name or email of the employee's manager

assignedItPerson.description: Name or email of the IT admin assigned to execute the offboarding

status.description: Current overall status of the offboarding workflow

notes.description: General notes or remarks for this offboarding record

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was initiated

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last modified

createdBy.description: Email or UID of the IT admin who created the record

ChecklistTemplate.title: Checklist Template
ChecklistTemplate.description: Default checklist template sections and items copied into new offboarding records.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the template was last modified

updatedBy.description: Email or UID of the IT admin who updated the template

AdminUser.title: Admin User
AdminUser.description: Authorized IT admin record stored in admins collection for RBAC validation.

/offboardings/{offboardingId}.description: Collection of employee offboarding records and their complete snapshot checklist.

/templates/{templateId}.description: Collection storing the master checklist templates.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Collection storing authorized IT admins for role-based access control.
